parts:
The first thing I'd say is to use [ instead of subset().

With dynamic UI, the initial value of the input will be NULL. It looks like output$roundControls is where you're creating the input for round_select -- but you're doing a comparison against input$round_select, so that will be NULL on the first run through. You'll need to gracefully handle that case so that you can create the round_select input in the first place.

-Winston

Seems to me like the roundControls needs to work on pre-filtered data, since you want to show the entire list of available rounds; while auditCounts wants to look at post-filtered data, i.e. just the selected rounds (if any).

In the below, clientData is pre-filtered and filteredClientData is post-filtered. I'm sure I messed something up in the actual filtering logic but hopefully the structure makes sense to you.


shinyServer(function(input, output) {

  clientData <- reactive({
    if (is.null(input$client_select))
      return(NULL)
    get(input$client_select)
  })

  filteredClientData <- reactive({
    dat <- clientData()
    if (is.null(dat))
      return(NULL)
    if (!is.null(input$round_select))
      dat <- dat[dat$Round %in% input$round_select]
    return(dat)

})
 
  # Dynamic UI experiment
  output$roundControls <- renderUI({
if (is.null(clientData()))
return("No client selected")

checkboxGroupInput("round_select", 
                       "Choose Round:",

as.character(levels(clientData$Round)),
                       selected = input$round_select)

})
 
  # audit count
  output$auditsCount <- renderText({
if (is.null(filteredClientData()))
return("No client selected")

paste("Total Audits:",nrow(filteredClientData()))
  })
